description: The verification plan names command classes but does not specify exact executable commands or concrete output paths, and it delegates coverage to a threshold that the draft contract never declares. Therefore CRIT-003 and CRIT-005 cannot be adjudicated reproducibly or as binary PASS/FAIL. Add exact commands, expected exits/counts, evidence paths, source-snapshot binding, and numeric line/function coverage thresholds for every L1, L2, boundary, security, purity, and process obligation.
